name: Colin the Janitor
edition: Silent Hill (2006), crawling creature in the Darkness
historicalSource: art/provenance-art92-e.json: no generation attempted. Old 57/132, PSP wallpapers and press scans show the restrained version in the restroom; never counted as framing the complete crawler.
combatRole: scripted-encounter; no combat view or attacks recommended
conclusion: Candidate for full-subject front-facing selection portrait in the compact crawling pose observed. The practical body plan and extremities are corroborated by the practical set footage plus the matching final film silhouette. No isolated final 360° turntable found.

directSources.type: interview with visual effects supervisor Evan Jacobs, 15 May 2006
directSources.finding: Paul Jones designed the crawling character with backward-bent dummy legs; feet are attached near the head. The real legs in green pants were removed in postproduction. The practical dummy legs are therefore part of the intended final character, and green pants/legs are not.
Separates two builds: mummified Fog World finding and moving Darkness crawler. Only the latter is used here.
Gans distinguishes historical person, dead finding and supernatural monster.

images.source: Official 2006 DVD documentary Path of Darkness; republished by DVDXtras
images.visualFinding: Bright practical front view encompasses the intended compact subject: crown, two elevated folded legs, torso and both arms and hands. One green crew-effect leg and foreground equipment/person outside the creature are excluded. Natural overlap of feet at rear is supplemented by side view.

images.source: DVD chapter Creatures Unleashed, channel Creature Features
images.visualFinding: Oblique/side set view with both dummy feet and folded-upswept lower legs above the back/head, separate from the green legs extending along the floor behind the performer. Front torso is partially cropped; this is side detail only.
Shows folded leg silhouette and recognizable foot against the head in near front view; cropped lower arms, not a complete reference in isolation.

images.source: Finished film excerpt, KinoCheck Clip channel states courtesy of Sony Pictures
images.visualFinding: Dark final graded shot of the creature at floor level, both arms supporting its upper body, with the compact dummy legs behind the shoulders and no green limbs extending behind. Does not on its own resolve all toes or the underside.

notSourceArt: Green pants and real legs, camera crew, furniture, toilet, floor and wall are not part of the creature.
Only native extracted crops below are source images. File names containing diagnostic or inventory are inspection aids, never source originals.
limitations: Source frames are 160×90, 319×180 and 320×180 platform storyboard samples of the original DVD documentary and the released film; do not claim a full-resolution source. Some tiles contain pillarboxing.
The final film plan is dark and overlapping, not an isolated turntable. The brighter production footage distinguishes practical dummy legs from the green limbs removed in postproduction.
Opposite/rear view, detailed wire routing, toes and full off-camera underside are not certified. Do not invent a standing silhouette or extend limbs from the mummified form.
This report performs no generation, artwork alteration, registry mutation or 1:1 certification.
